Should be Floor Standing Vacuum Automatic Tissue Processor. 2. Overall dimensions (DxWxH): 700 x 600 x 1050 mm approx.

3. Weight: 150-200 Kg. approx. 4. Reagent reservoirs: Ten, max. 3 litres (processing: 3 L) 5. Paraffin reservoirs: Four, max. 3 litres (processing: 3L) 6. Cleaning reservoir: 3 Nos. (3 litres) 7. Processing capacity: 250-300 cassettes. 8. Fume Control: Disposable carbon filter. Program memory: 20 processing programs. Standard (upto 100 can be provided additi 9. onally) 10. Carry-over protection: Lines automatically blown dry following pumping. 20. Should have Automatic Reagent Management System. 21. Password protection: Two-level (one Manager and one user password). 22. Should have inbuilt power backup system for at least 1 hour. 23. Should have Solvent Resistant LCD touch screen for programming & operation. 24. Should be able to run rapid protocol. Should be fully enclosed to minimize the evaporation of reagents during processing & 25. storage. Company should supply the following accessories with the machine:- (i) Spare 5 Reag 26. ent Bottles. (ii) Regular Cassettes-5000 Nos., Biopsy Cassettes-5000 Nos., Jumbo Cass ettes-5000 Nos. 27. Should have option for Remote fill and drain feature. 28. Should have Remote service for real time application and service support. 29. Unit should be CE/FDA enlisted.
